steps: dash.cloudflare.com → the account with vidalia.pro and vidalia.church (nameservers alfred / sue) → vidalia.pro → DNS → Records
vidalia.pro: add Type A, Name @, IPv4 76.76.21.21, Proxy status OFF (grey cloud)

Switch to vidalia.church → DNS: add Type A, Name @, 76.76.21.21, proxy OFF; and CNAME www → cname.vercel-dns.com, proxy OFF. Don't add records for church names; the website builder adds those itself
Don't add a wildcard (*) record on either domain
For Google: search.google.com/search-console → Add property → Domain → vidalia.pro → copy the TXT value → add it in Cloudflare as Type TXT, Name @ → Verify. Repeat for vidalia.church
Tell an agent it's done: it checks the certificates, switches the pages to the vidalia.pro address, and submits the sitemaps

tasks.title: Set the order-by dates for Thanksgiving and Christmas engraved gifts
tasks.why: Shoppers decide on 'will it arrive in time?'. The seasonal pages say 'made to order, order early' until you give real dates. Agents won't guess your production time.
steps: Decide how many days you need to make an order, and how you deliver (pickup in Vidalia, local delivery, shipping)
Tell an agent: the last order date for Thanksgiving (Nov 26) and for Christmas, for pickup and for shipping. It puts them on the pages and in the FAQ

tasks.title: Upload your blank folders (charcuterie boards, trays, coasters) in the laser shop admin
tasks.why: The shop can only sell what's in its catalog. One upload feeds the shop, the seasonal pages, the ready-to-order pages and the Google feed. New uploads stay hidden until you set a price.
steps: laser.engrave.market/admin → sign in → Products → Upload blank photos
Drag in whole folders, several at once, or a .zip (charcuterie boards, coasters, trays). It works from a computer; on a phone, choose the files
For each new product: set the price, size and wood, then turn it on
For public pages and Google, use your own photo of an engraved piece when you have one. Hobby Lobby's listing photos are their images, so use them only as a stand-in until you shoot your own
tasks.source: Owner sent Hobby Lobby blank photos 2026-11-04

tasks.title: Add New Year's icons, and confirm your clipart licenses allow selling engraved items
tasks.why: Your 85 Christmas icons and 3 fall designs are in the design picker now, but there are no New Year's icons (those designs are text-only for now). The bundles look like marketplace clipart; their license must allow use on products you sell.
steps: If you want New Year's art, buy or make a small bundle (2027, fireworks, champagne) and upload it in Admin → Design assets
Check the license of each bundle you uploaded on Sept 26 (Christmas animal 'breakouts', Santa, manger, campfire, autumn goat) allows commercial physical products

tasks.title: Price and turn on the 3 ready-to-order Christmas pieces (their pages are built)
tasks.why: The pages for the walnut Merry Christmas board, the acacia serving board and the snowman coaster are live but hidden. Each one appears on the Christmas, Thanksgiving and gift pages, in Google Shopping and in the sitemap as soon as it has a price and is turned on.
steps: laser.engrave.market/admin → Products → edit BOARD-WALNUT-PADDLE-MERRYXMAS: set the price, engraving price, size and how many you have, then tick Active
Same for BOARD-ACACIA-SERVING-MERRYXMAS and COAST-HEX-SNOWMAN
If words on the back (From ___ / year) should cost extra, set the back-side price in the same form
Optional: upload your 'Merry Christmas + tree' design file and tell an agent, so each order carries the front file too (the snowman already has its file)
Optional: OK to show the 'Plemons' family-name board photos? They show a real customer's name
